name: The onboarding attempt starts with no residential sites
title: SC-13-26-01 The onboarding attempt starts with no residential sites
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given an isolated E2E database with system configuration and a SaaS administrator
When the administrator requests the site list
Then the site list is empty
And no shared development or production data has been reset
